missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 2/5 - HAINAUT OFFENSIVE. The South answers on the ground. Three armoured columns roll north out of Hainaut towards Ronse, Geraardsbergen and Halle, behind a rocket artillery screen near Chievres. The North holds a thin line along the language border and has a reserve at Aalst. SOUTH: break 70% of the northern line. NORTH: destroy 75% of the three columns. Both sides playable: PvP, or co-op against the AI. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.

objectives.DisplayName: Break the northern line at Ronse, Geraardsbergen and Halle

outcomes.Message: First column moving from Tournai towards Ronse.
Second column through Lessines, heading for Geraardsbergen.
Third column out of Soignies, driving on Halle and the road to Brussels.
The northern line has collapsed. The road to Brussels is open.
The southern offensive has burned out in the Flemish Ardennes. The line holds.
The Aalst reserve is moving up to Geraardsbergen. Cover it.
South, the offensive begins. Keep their aircraft off our columns and open the way north.
North, armour is massing in Hainaut. Hold the language border.
Hit the columns at the crossings, and find the rocket artillery near Chievres.
